# Office Facilities Handbook (Org B fixture)

Owner: Facilities (Org B)
Audience: Org B staff only

## Parking

Org B staff register vehicles with the front desk. Parking bays are
allocated per floor; visitor bays are marked V1-V8.

## Meeting rooms

Book rooms through the facilities panel. Rooms A and B need 24-hour
notice. Catering requests go to Facilities, not IT.
